title: Sidebar HUD panel with click-to-load model list
description:
Follow-up to VIEW-7 which shipped keyboard-driven interaction (P, Shift+P, [/]) and terminal logging for model state. This ticket adds the visual sidebar the user asked for.

Requirements:
- Right-edge HUD panel, always visible (non-modal).
- Header rows: current model name, patch overlay state, shader mode.
- Scrollable model list from ModelCatalog with current entry highlighted.
- Click row to loadModel(entry).
- Uses Camera2D + HyperString + Drawing.getDrawing().font pattern from MainScene/TradeScene.

Implementation notes:
- MeshNodeViewerScene doesn't currently have a Camera2D; add one like MainScene does.
- Set up mouse-region click handling similar to MenuBox's subscribe pattern.
- Reuse colour constants from ixdar.graphics.render.color.Color.

Depends on: VIEW-5 and VIEW-7 (both landed).
definition-of-done: Visual sidebar panel appears on viewer right. Click a model → loads. Highlight + scroll behave correctly. Patch-overlay + shader-mode toggles are visible in the panel.
testing-plan: Launch viewer, panel visible. Click each entry, model loads and highlight moves. Scroll the list. Toggle overlay + mode via both keyboard and panel buttons.
